theme.description: Modern Industrial Electric: Sleek dark base with amber/copper accents and interactive circuit glow micro-animations. Evokes trust, precision, and elite engineering.

headings.usage: Use for all H1, H2, H3. Apply tracking-tight or tracking-tighter for a heavy-weight industrial feel. DO NOT USE INTER FOR HEADINGS.

body.usage: Use for paragraphs, descriptions, and labels.

mono.usage: Use for ROI Calculator numbers, Estimator values, Job ID lookup, and technical specs.

rules: No generic full-screen gradients. Use matte dark backgrounds with targeted glow effects (e.g., radial-gradient behind a key component).
Hover states MUST have a lighter hue of the active state color.
Never use pure black #000000 without a tint. Stick to #0A0A0A (Obsidian).

surfaces_and_micro_themes.header: Crystal Glass variant: bg-black/60 with backdrop-blur-xl and border-b border-white/10. NO purely transparent headers.
surfaces_and_micro_themes.estimator_card: The 'Tracing Beam' Variant. Add a glowing border effect or an inner 1px solid stroke of white/10 with an orange glow blur-md behind it.
surfaces_and_micro_themes.grid_sections: Grid Borders ('Technical' Look): border-collapse style with border-r border-b border-white/10 on items to expose the skeleton.
surfaces_and_micro_themes.buttons: Industrial Pill/Rectangle: Sharp edges (rounded-sm or rounded-none) with high-contrast text. Use subtle box-shadow for depth.

layout_and_spacing.spacing_system: Generous Spacing: Use p-8, p-12, p-24 for padding. Inside containers, use p-6 or p-8 to prevent text collision with borders.
layout_and_spacing.bento_grid: MODE A (Tetris Grid): Use for Genius Conversion Suite (case studies, brochures). Mix square (col-span-4), tall (row-span-2), and wide (col-span-8) items.
layout_and_spacing.alignment: Mobile-First. Never center by default. Left-align text for technical descriptions. Optical alignment for icons inside buttons.

motion_and_interactions.hover_states: Micro-animations on ALL interactive elements. Slight lift (-translate-y-1) and glow on cards.
motion_and_interactions.circuit_glow: Use Framer Motion to create 'moving energy' lines (opacity sweeps) across borders or dividers.
motion_and_interactions.accessibility: Respect prefers-reduced-motion. Ensure focus states use a high-contrast ring.
motion_and_interactions.transitions: Use specific properties like transition-transform duration-300 ease-out. NO transition-all.

components.hero: High-impact overlay (bg-black/50 to bg-black/70) over industrial background video/image. Massive H1 (text-5xl to 6xl+) in Barlow Condensed.
components.emergency_dispatch_modal: Shadcn Dialog. High contrast (Warning Red/Yellow accents). Include a pulsing 'Live' dot animation. Sticky Emergency CTA Bar at the bottom of the viewport.
components.estimator_and_roi_calculator: Custom interactive forms using Shadcn Slider, Input, and Select. Use JetBrains Mono for numbers. Display immediate dynamic calculations.
components.status_tracker: Vertical or horizontal timeline layout. Glowing active steps with circuit-like connecting lines.
components.before_after_slider: Custom draggable component overlaid on two images (dirty vs rewound motor).
components.gov_badges_marquee: react-fast-marquee with 'Editorial Ribbon' style. Low contrast pale/dark background, slow smooth drift.
components.whatsapp_cta: Floating button (bottom-right) using react-icons/fa (FaWhatsapp). Bright green or matching brand copper.

libraries.icons: react-icons (for FaWhatsapp, GoGov badges, etc.), lucide-react for standard UI.
libraries.motion: framer-motion (for micro-animations, tracing borders, reveal effects)
libraries.ui: shadcn/ui (customized for sharp edges and dark mode)

hero_background.description: Close up of a machine with a spiral design (copper/metal). Use with dark overlay.

before_after_1.description: Circular object/copper motor core. Use for 'After' showcase.

industrial_background.description: Black and white photo of a factory. Use for Service Coverage Area or About section.

electric_circuit.description: Motherboard/circuit in the dark. Use for ROI/Tech highlights background.

emergency_arc.description: Bright blue electrical arcs. Use for Emergency Breakdown Dispatch Modal background.

media.rules: Never use placeholder images. If rendering images with overlays, ensure contrast is accessible.

testing.attributes: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Avoid this. Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Ensure dark mode is fully supported. This is a dark-first industrial application.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Do NOT apply universal transitions (transition: all). Target specific properties.
Do NOT center align the app container. Use left-aligned layouts for technical and tabular data.
Every interaction needs micro-animations. Static = dead.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui.
For toasts, use the sonner component from Shadcn.
